title: Verification report conversion
responsibility: Converts stored verification captures and outcomes into the existing report-view format.

inputs.name: mediaFile.capture
inputs.description: Capture whose media name is requested.

inputs.name: harnessEvidence.record
inputs.description: Record whose screenshot and audio captures should appear.

inputs.name: harnessReport.summary
inputs.description: Revision summary supplying title and commit identity.

inputs.name: harnessReport.record
inputs.description: Record supplying results, checks, failures and gates.

outputs.name: mediaFile
outputs.description: Media name without a leading media/ prefix, or an empty string for null media.

outputs.name: harnessEvidence
outputs.description: Ordered screenshot/audio gallery items retaining missing media and provenance. Invalid records produce not-proven item statuses; each capture has a unique sequence-based identifier.

outputs.name: harnessReport
outputs.description: Finalized historical Report with recorded tests, failures, gate acceptance text and evidence. State coverage maps inapplicable to skipped, missing/empty captures to not-proven, otherwise capture statuses to passed or failed.
